ConnectionStrings.//: Set via user secrets or environment variables. Never commit credentials (SOW 3 - Security).

Collection.//: Sources are seeded in collect.DataSource: BLS_CPI (series CUUR0000SA0) and NYFED_SOFR (the current calendar year, rate type SOFR). Enable or disable a source by its IsEnabled row, not here.

Bls.//: ApiKey is deliberately absent. Supply it with: dotnet user-secrets set "Collection:Bls:ApiKey" "<key>". Without a key the v2 API still works under a much smaller daily quota.
